page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The marginal note "Paulo supra bis.a." is uncertain as to its exact form. The left-margin note labels "Poffevin" and "Sanpleton" are read as printed and are uncertain ("Possevin", "Stapleton" are likely). The note "Tert.Praescrip." is read from the margin as printed. The word "respondendum" at the line end is partly obscured and may read "respondendu". Note markers q, r, t and * are read from small superscript letters in the text and may be misplaced. The last word of the page, "diucle-", breaks at the line end and is continued by the catchword "re".
